saints.name: St. Anthony Zaccaria
saints.title: Priest and Founder
saints.shortBlurb: A physician turned priest who founded the Barnabites and preached reform of morals in Milan…
biography: Born at Cremona in 1502, Anthony Mary Zaccaria first studied medicine at Padua, then, drawn to care for souls as well as bodies, was ordained a priest. In an age hungry for reform he preached fervently in Milan and founded the Clerics Regular of St. Paul, known as the Barnabites after their church of St. Barnabas.

He promoted frequent Communion, devotion to the Passion of Christ, and the public exposition of the Blessed Sacrament, and is associated with the spread of the Forty Hours' devotion. Worn out by his labors, he died at Cremona in 1539 at the age of thirty-six.
saints.knownFor: Founding the Barnabites and reviving fervent devotion to the Eucharist.
